content: BABEL-JA NYUNYPAL JIRNIJANAKU MUWARR NGARRKALU (11:1-9)
Palaja punja waraja muwarr ngarrany muwarr pirnikinyiyi marrngurrangulu.
Kakarrakurnu yana-yananyikinyayi. Parlkarranga wirtungu turlpanyayi, kakarrakurnungu. Yini pala warrarn Babylonia.

Muwarr pirnayarningu, “Munu jirrja yankuluminyi, ngunarrikurnujirri. Kunmu wantuluminyi. Nyungungungarra wantuluminyi, ngatu. Ngurra wirtu yarni malaminya, warnkukapali pukurl wirtu yarni malaminyi, nganimarta yiji, kankakurnu, parlparrkartijakun. Wiyirrju jintarrangulu nganyjurru wurralapiyinganyjurrinyi. Wurralapiyi, ‘Ngurnungurrangu marrngurrangu Babylonia-nga, yalyjirr waninyayi, miranu yiji jana.’” Parla maninyikinyiya, purikarrangu jirnikinyiya, kamparnakinyiyi wikanga kararr jinaku, kurrngal yarni marnakinyiyi yija. Kulurnu mantarnakinyayijaninyi bitumen-ju. Yarni marnayi, yarni marnayi.

Ngarrkangarra milpanya pala city-pa tower-ku yirrinaku. Miranu waninyikinyajanaku. Wurrarna palinyju, “Kunmu waninyayi, warajajakun muwarrjartiny. Palajalu nyungungarra jirniyi. Yarti nganiwarralpirtiku karrinyayi, pala jilkulupiyi. Yarranakanu jiti kurlu jiliyili.
Yuu, palangamarra katukalkunya, nyunypaly jilaminyijanaku muwarr, warinypa wariny muwarr pilipiyi. Palaja munu kurlkapirli wantulupiyarningu.”

Pala jirni Ngarrkalu. Nyunypaly jirni muwarr janamili. Wiyirr jirrja jirnijaninyi ngunarrijirri. Munu yarranakanu yarni marnamiyi ngurra wirtujina janamili, warnkukapalipa wirtujina yija. Yakarnayi kuta ngarrany, kakuputu yakarniya.
Yini pala ngurra “Babel”. Pala muwarr “Babel” wurraninyi, “Kakurnayarningu Muwarr Yajarri.” Ngurnjurn-ngurnjurnayarningu muwarrku.
SHEM-MILI PARTANY ARPACHSHAD NYIRRIRNIKARTIJARRANGU KANYAJANINYI (11:10-26)
Nyungurrangu nyirrirnikartijarrangu Shem-mili Arpachshad-ja. Mangkurtu jarrinyaja kujarra partunujirrija, Shem 100 partunurrangujartiny, japartu jarrinyi pirirriku partanyku, yini marna Arpachshad.
Palaja Shem wanka jarrinyikinyi 500 partunurrangu, partanykarrangu pirirripa mirtawa kanyajaninyi.
Arpachshad 35 partunurrangujartiny jarrinyaja, partany pirirri kanya, Shelah.
Palaja Arpachshad wanka jarrinyikinyi 403 partunurrangu, partanykarrangu pirirripa mirtawa kanyajaninyi.
Shelah 30 partunurrangujartiny jarrinyaja, partany pirirri kanya, Eber.
Palaja Arpachshad wanka jarrinyikinyi 403 partunurrangu, partanykarrangu pirirripa mirtawa kanyajaninyi.
Eber 34 partunurrangujartiny jarrinyaja, partany pirirri kanya, Peleg.
Palaja Eber wanka jarrinyikinyi 430 partunurrangu, partanykarrangu pirirripa mirtawa kanyajaninyi.
Peleg 30 partunurrangujartiny jarrinyaja, partany pirirri kanya, Reu.
Palaja Peleg wanka jarrinyikinyi 209 partunurrangu, partanykarrangu pirirripa mirtawa kanyajaninyi.
Reu 32 partunurrangujartiny jarrinyaja, partany pirirri kanya, Serug.
Palaja Reu wanka jarrinyikinyi 207 partunurrangu, partanykarrangu pirirripa mirtawa kanyajaninyi.
Serug 30 partunurrangujartiny jarrinyaja, partany pirirri kanya, Nahor.
Palaja Serug wanka jarrinyikinyi 200 partunurrangu, partanykarrangu pirirripa mirtawa kanyajaninyi.
Nahor 29 partunurrangujartiny jarrinyaja, partany pirirri kanya, Terah.
Palaja Nahor wanka jarrinyikinyi 119 partunurrangu, partanykarrangu pirirripa mirtawa kanyajaninyi.
Terah 70 partunurrangu jarrinyi, palaja japartu jarrinyi Abram-kupa Nahor-pa Haran.
TERAH, ABRAM-MILI JAPARTU (11:27-32)

Punjaja nyarraja mangkurtuja wirtuja pirirri turlpanya, yini paliny Terah. Ngurrara paliny warrarnja Chaldea-nga. Tawunja waninyikinyi, yiningi Ur-unga. Paliny partanykarrangujartiny kujarrapa waraja, yini Nahor-pa Abram-pa Haran. (Nyarra Haran partanykarrangujartiny, partany yini Lot, kurntaljirri yinijirri Milcah-pa Ishcah.) Wankanyungu Terah-nga, Haran marlkarri jarrinyi, palinymilingi warrarnja, palanga tawunja Ur-unga.
Warajanga jarrinyipulu Nahor-pa Haran-mili kurntal, Milcah. Warajanga jarrinyipulu Abram-pa Sarai, nyungujirri. [??Translation Team to decide.]
Sarai-lu munu partany kangama, partanymajirri waninyikinyi.

Palaja Terah-lu yakarna pala tawun. Kanyajaninyi palinymili partany, Abram, palinymili ngarraya, Sarai, palinymili karluji, Lot, janajakun. Karakurnu yananyikinyiyi warrarnkarti warinykarti, Canaan-karti. Partijirri kajarnayi, tawunja yiningi Haran-ja. Palamanga ngatu waninyiyi punja.
Palamangangarra marlkarri jarrinyi Terah, Haran-ja. Ranyji yija-yiji paliny, partunurrangujartiny kurrngaljartiny, 205-jartiny.
